PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peaking Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak for powerlifting meet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peak Week 1 (21-15 days out)" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Squat Focus Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          squat 2x1 rpe 8.5 rest 240 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Bench Focus Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 1x3 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x5 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Deadlift Focus Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 1x3 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          deadlift 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8.5 rest 270 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x6 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Bench Technical":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Peak Week 2 (14-8 days out)" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Squat Heavy Singles":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x2 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          squat 3x1 rpe 8.5 rest 240 seconds
          squat 2x1 rpe 9 rest 300 seconds
          leg_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Bench Heavy Singles":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 1x2 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 9 rest 210 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Deadlift Heavy Singles":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 1x2 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          deadlift 3x1 rpe 8.5 rest 270 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 9 rest 300 seconds
          barbell_row 2x5 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 35m "Bench Speed and Technique":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x2 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Meet Week (7-0 days out)" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Last Heavy Singles (Openers ~90-92%)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8.5 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8.5 rest 270 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Technical Taper":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 7.5 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 7.5 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 7.5 rest 210 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Priming and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          squat 2x1 rpe 6.5 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Sunday training 10m "Meet Day Warmup (Guideline)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
